Roles Held

Head of Data ............................. Jan 2022 – to date

▪ Introduced a feature store and model registry; time from idea to production fell from 5 months to 6 weeks
▪ Report to the COO and sit on the risk committee
▪ Hired nine people in two years and started a graduate rotation that has placed six graduates
▪ Negotiated the move to a single cloud data platform, replacing four legacy warehouses

Senior Data Scientist ........................ Jul 2018 – Dec 2021
▪ Built the demand forecasting system used by 600 stores (gradient boosting, hierarchical reconciliation)
▪ Used Principal Component Analysis and clustering to group 2,000 products into 40 ranges
▪ Ran 60 online experiments with the marketing team
▪ Mentored five junior scientists and introduced model cards for every production model
Tools: Python, R, Spark, Databricks, Airflow
